K8 Building Tech Pty Ltd offers market-leading solutions and products for the commercial and residential construction sectors, specialising in thermal, acoustic and fire-rated building systems. Working with leading manufacturers and suppliers, we deliver high-quality building solutions for projects ranging from single residential dwellings to Tier 1 commercial developments.

Due to continued business growth, K8 Building Tech Pty Ltd is seeking a dedicated full-time Procurement Specialist to enhance procurement effectiveness across the business. The role will provide strategic advice to management on sourcing strategies, supplier performance, procurement processes, inventory optimisation and continuous improvement initiatives. This position is based at our head office in Port Melbourne, Victoria.

Base salary: $79,423 (plus super)

Main tasks include:
•	Analyse procurement requirements, demand forecasts and inventory information to develop sourcing strategies and purchasing plans that support business objectives.
•	Source, assess and recommend suppliers by evaluating pricing, product quality, lead times, service capability and overall commercial value.
•	Manage supplier relationships and support commercial negotiations relating to pricing, supply arrangements and procurement terms.
•	Monitor supplier performance, procurement expenditure and purchasing trends to identify cost-saving opportunities, manage supply risks and improve procurement outcomes.
•	Prepare procurement reports and provide insights and recommendations to management regarding procurement performance, supplier management and inventory optimisation.
•	Develop, implement and maintain procurement policies, procedures, documentation and governance frameworks to support consistent and compliant procurement practices.
•	Support the optimisation and ongoing use of MYOB Acumatica ERP to improve procurement processes, inventory visibility and business reporting capabilities.
•	Analyse procurement processes and performance indicators to identify improvement opportunities, enhance efficiency and strengthen supply chain outcomes.
•	Work collaboratively with sales, warehouse and management teams to align procurement strategies with customer demand, inventory requirements and operational priorities.
•	Support contract administration activities by maintaining supplier agreements, commercial documentation and procurement records.
Required Qualifications and Experience:
•	Bachelor’s degree or higher in Business, Commerce, Supply Chain Management, Procurement, Logistics, Operations Management or a related discipline.
•	Minimum 2–3 years’ experience in procurement, strategic sourcing, supply chain management or commercial procurement.
•	Experience within construction materials, building products, manufacturing or wholesale distribution industries is highly regarded.

Ideal Skills and Attributes:
•	Knowledge of ERP systems such as MYOB Acumatica, Oracle, or Microsoft Dynamics 365.
•	Strong analytical and commercial acumen.
•	Contract administration and negotiation skills.
•	Excellent stakeholder engagement, communication and organisational skills.

Retail Manager

Business: Shareefs Concord Pty Ltd (Trading as Shareef's – The Shawarma Social Club)
Location: Concord NSW 2137
Employment Type: Full-time, Ongoing
Salary: AUD $75,000 – $85,000 per annum plus superannuation

About the Business
Shareefs Concord Pty Ltd, trading as Shareef's – The Shawarma Social Club, is a contemporary Lebanese quick-service restaurant located in Concord, New South Wales. Inspired by the vibrant café culture of 1960s and 1970s Beirut, the business specialises in authentic Lebanese shawarma and Mediterranean-inspired cuisine, delivering exceptional dine-in, takeaway, catering, and delivery services to customers throughout Sydney. The business combines traditional flavours with modern hospitality practices to provide a distinctive and memorable dining experience. 
Operating within Australia's highly competitive hospitality and food service industry, Shareef's is committed to maintaining exceptional food quality, outstanding customer service, and operational excellence across all aspects of its business. The restaurant operates in a fast-paced environment requiring effective workforce management, inventory control, quality assurance, and strict compliance with food safety and workplace obligations. The business is built upon strong values of authenticity, innovation, customer satisfaction, and continuous improvement while maintaining compliance with all relevant Australian hospitality and workplace regulations. 
With increasing customer demand, expanding operational requirements, and continued business growth, Shareefs Concord Pty Ltd requires an experienced Retail Manager to provide dedicated operational leadership across the restaurant's daily operations. The role is essential to maintaining service quality, managing workforce performance, ensuring regulatory compliance, and supporting the continued growth and sustainability of the business.

Position Overview
The Retail Manager is responsible for the end-to-end management of the restaurant's daily operations, ensuring efficient service delivery, strong financial performance, exceptional customer experiences, and effective workforce management. The position requires hands-on leadership within a high-volume hospitality environment and accountability for operational compliance, people management, inventory control, food quality standards, and business performance.
Working closely with kitchen staff, customer service employees, suppliers, and senior management, the Retail Manager plays a critical role in maintaining operational excellence while ensuring that Shareef's continues to deliver authentic Lebanese cuisine and outstanding hospitality experiences to its customers.
This is a senior operational position ideally suited to an experienced hospitality professional capable of leading teams, maintaining operational standards, and driving continuous business improvement within a fast-paced restaurant environment.

Key Responsibilities
Restaurant Operations and Performance
•	Plan, coordinate, and manage the day-to-day operations of the restaurant to achieve sales, service, and productivity objectives.
•	Ensure consistent compliance with operational procedures, food safety standards, and workplace health and safety requirements.
•	Monitor business performance indicators, including labour costs, food costs, wastage, profitability, and operational efficiency.
•	Maintain consistently high standards of food quality, customer service, and restaurant presentation.
Leadership and Workforce Management
•	Recruit, train, roster, supervise, and motivate restaurant employees across customer service and kitchen operations.
•	Provide ongoing coaching, performance feedback, and professional development opportunities to team members.
•	Foster a positive workplace culture focused on teamwork, accountability, customer service excellence, and continuous improvement.
•	Manage staffing requirements to ensure adequate workforce coverage during peak trading periods.
Customer Service and Hospitality Management
•	Oversee customer service delivery across dine-in, takeaway, catering, and delivery service channels.
•	Resolve customer enquiries, feedback, and complaints promptly and professionally.
•	Maintain exceptional hospitality standards that enhance customer satisfaction and encourage repeat patronage.
•	Monitor customer experiences and implement service improvements where appropriate.
Inventory Management and Cost Control
•	Manage inventory levels, supplier relationships, stock ordering, deliveries, and stock rotation processes.
•	Conduct regular stocktakes and implement cost control measures to minimise wastage and maximise profitability.
•	Monitor operational expenditure and identify opportunities to improve business performance.
•	Ensure restaurant equipment and operational assets are appropriately maintained and fully operational.
Compliance and Administration
•	Ensure compliance with Fair Work obligations, food safety legislation, workplace health and safety requirements, and internal operational policies.
•	Prepare operational reports, sales summaries, stock reports, and performance data as required by management.
•	Maintain accurate business records and implement organisational policies and procedures across all operational areas.
•	Assist in implementing continuous improvement initiatives that support operational excellence and business sustainability.

Skills & Experience
Essential Requirements
•	Proven experience in retail or hospitality management within a fast-paced environment
•	Strong leadership capability with demonstrated experience managing teams and rosters
•	Sound understanding of cost control, inventory management, and retail performance metrics
•	High level of organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills
•	Ability to work flexible hours including evenings, weekends, and public holidays

Preferred Qualifications
•	AQF Associate Degree, Advanced Diploma or Diploma (ANZSCO Skill Level 2)
•	At least three years of relevant experience may substitute for the formal qualifications listed above. In some instances relevant experience and/or on-the-job training may be required in addition to the formal qualification.
•	Current food safety certification or willingness to obtain
•	Prior experience within QSR or franchised food retail operations

Work Environment
The Retail Manager role is hands-on and operational, requiring active involvement on the shop floor alongside the team. The position demands strong time management, an open schedule resilience under pressure, and the ability to lead by example in a high-volume service environment.
Note - Preference will be given to Australian Citizens and Permanent Residents.

In the role of Area Manager, you will have autonomy to deliver known business outcomes within a transparent operational framework.

The role mainly consists of:
•	Completing contract reviews and negotiating variations with each of the clients
•	Preparing, reviewing and submitting monthly and quarterly reports concerning the contracts to clients and senior management
•	Develop, review and negotiate variations to the contract, programs, projects and services
•	Maintaining budgets, preparing and submitting annual contract cost increases 
•	Advising Executive Managers on matters requiring attention to ensure their decisions are implemented
•	Tracking and achieving contractual and business KPI’s including general strategy, contract retention and site/portfolio profitability 
•	Responding to inquiries, resolving problems concerning contracted services and implementing required changes
•	Recruiting, training and developing of the management team to ensure contract compliance and succession 
•	Oversee work by contractors and report on variations to work orders. 
•	Managing & owning customer relationships
•	Business development and profit optimisation across the contract portfolio
•	Managing paperwork related with contracts and variations

Skills and experience
The skills and qualifications that this position requires include:
•	Management and operations experience this is a necessity 
•	Minimum 2 years' experience in the titled role or a highly relevant field - such as Construction, Engineering, IT, Maintenance, etc.
•	Strong connection to our corporate culture and understanding of our values and ideals.
•	Accountability, autonomy, responsibility and adaptability are sought after qualities in the right candidate 

Remuneration/Salary
•	Market leading based on commensurate experience
•	Package to include vehicle allowance

Location:   Queanbeyan (Servicing Canberra & Regional NSW)  
  Travel:   Heavy local regional travel + interstate trips monthly (with overnight stays)  
 
   About the Company  
  Our client is within the fire and safety sector based out of Queanbeyan. Operating in an industry where compliance, responsiveness, and trust are non-negotiable, they provide critical safety solutions to commercial, residential, and tier-1 construction clients. Due to strong market demand and strategic growth plans, they are now seeking a sales focused Business Development Manager to increase their pipeline and drive revenue expansion.   
   About the Role  
  This is a role designed for a commercial sales professional who thrives on the road, building face-to-face relationships and closing high-value contracts. This is a new role for the business and while you will be supported by an internal team, the primary focus is pure business development, identifying new market opportunities, securing formal appointments with key decision-makers, and converting leads into long-term commercial accounts.   
  This role does require travel, split between the local market and travelling interstate to capture wider markets.  
   Key Responsibilities  
  New Business Generation & Pipeline Growth  
 
  Identify, target, and secure new business opportunities across Canberra, and the surrounding capital region.  
  Initiate contact with property managers, tier-1/2 builders, compliance officers, and strata managers to secure formal presentations and tender opportunities.  
  Conduct thorough assessments to understand client compliance needs, delivering tailored fire and safety solutions.  
  Lead the preparation and submission of comprehensive commercial proposals, ensuring alignment with client requirements and company profit margins.  
 
  Territory & Market Expansion  
 
  Actively manage your schedule to maintain a high-visibility presence on the ground across the region.  
  Undertake interstate overnight trips to pitch to national accounts, secure large-scale contracts, and establish new regional footprints.  
  Stay ahead of building code changes, industry regulations, and competitor movements to position our client as the preferred provider.  
 
  Strategic Sales Leadership  
 
  Work closely with the internal sales team to align lead generation with overall company revenue objectives.  
  Review the active sales pipeline weekly to identify any friction points in the sales cycle - step in to assist with closing complex deals, and ensure momentum is maintained.  
  Maintain meticulous records of client interactions, upcoming opportunities, and forecasting metrics within the CRM to guide strategic decision-making.  
 
   What You Bring  
 
  Minimum 2 years of experience in a Business Development or a consultative Sales role, ideally within construction, building materials, trade services, or the fire/safety sector.  
  A proven track record of successfully opening doors, cold-calling, and converting cold prospects into loyal clients.  
  Outstanding communication and negotiation skills, with the ability to build immediate rapport with both site managers and corporate executives.  
  Highly self-motivated, disciplined with time management, and comfortable working autonomously while frequently on the road.  
  A valid Australian driver's license is essential, along with a genuine willingness to undertake heavy local driving and required interstate overnight trips.  
  A solid understanding of workplace health and safety (WHS) and building compliance standards is highly regarded.  
 
 
  To Apply  
  If you are a driven sales professional ready to take ownership of a lucrative territory and drive substantial business growth, we want to hear from you.  

 At Randstad, we are passionate about providing equal employment opportunities and embracing diversity to the benefit of all. We actively encourage applications from any background. 
   
    Please  click here  to apply.
